question.text: Regarding the oxidation states of elements of transition element the incorrect statement is

options.text: Oxoanion of  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">r</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>6</mn></mrow></msup></math> in acidic medium is better oxidizing agent than oxides of Mo and W in +6 oxidation state.
Higher oxidation states are shown by metals when they are attached to <math><mi mathvariant="normal">π</mi></math> - acceptor ligands.

solution.text: Lower oxidation states are shown by metals when they are attached to <math><mi mathvariant="normal">π</mi></math> - acceptors ligands.
